MASTERBRAIN — KEYS AND TIMING

We read the original source and played two guesses using Fuse 1.6.0 with the 48K machine.

Press any key at the tape stop message, then enter an age and press Enter. The source accepts colors 3, 4, 5, and 6, named magenta, green, cyan, and yellow. Type four digits in that range per guess, then Enter. We entered 3333 and 4444; the game displayed both rows with color marks and updated its guess number.

From the repository root, run:
  sh src/assets/basic-src/original-sinclair-basic-collections/Granada-Publishing/10-mastermind/BASIC/REPLAY.sh

Fuse runs at 100% speed. These are wall-clock waits:

  1. Load the original TAP on the 48K ROM. Wait 3 seconds.
  2. Press Space for 0.18 seconds; wait 2 seconds.
  3. Enter 20 and Return; wait 2 seconds.
  4. Enter 3333 and Return; wait 2 seconds; save 01-AFTER-3333.png.
  5. Enter 4444 and Return; wait 2 seconds; save 02-AFTER-4444.png.

The replay checks changes in the guess area. The secret is chosen by the original program. Two guesses do not prove a win. The tape's stop notice may remain visible over some of the text.
